item.title: Google Summer of Code 2025 Projects Announced
item.description:
The FreeCAD project got three students in this year’s Google Summer of Code program.

Here are the projects:

  1. chiragsingh1711 will enhance the TechDraw workbench to enable 3D PDF exporting. Users will be able to create standard technical drawings with traditional orthographic views and dimensions, plus an interactive 3D view that appears as a regular isometric view in print but becomes fully interactive when viewed digitally.

Mentors: Pieter Hijma, reqrefusion, CADialog.

item.title: GSoC projects in 2024
item.description:
This year, we have two students working on FreeCAD as part of the annual Google Summer of Code program.

Harshita Saraswat is creating a command-line tool to manage and manipulate FreeCAD preferences from outside the FreeCAD application. This tool is intended to be used for installing and configuring FreeCAD with scripts. Harshita is mentored by Ajinkya Dahale and Pieter Hijma.
